description: This is a unit test class for the DateTimeHelperService, testing various date and time utility functions such as formatting, comparison, range generation, timezone calculation, and week boundary determination.

classes.name: DateTimeHelperServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class that verifies the correct behavior of DateTimeHelperService utility functions.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the DateTimeHelperService instance before each test.

methods.name: testFormatDateTimeToYmd
methods.description: Tests formatting a DateTime object to 'Y-m-d' string, including timezone adjustments and null case.

methods.name: testFormatDateTimeToTimeString
methods.description: Tests formatting a DateTime object to 'H:i' string with timezone adjustments and null case.

methods.name: testIsDatesEqual
methods.description: Verifies date equality logic, considering timezone differences and null inputs.

methods.name: testDateDiffInHours
methods.description: Checks correctness of calculated hours difference between two DateTime objects.

methods.name: testDateRange
methods.description: Ensures date range generation produces correct sequences of dates with various intervals.

methods.name: assertDateArray
methods.description: Helper method to assert that an array of DateTime objects matches expected date strings.

methods.name: testGetNow
methods.description: Validates that getNow returns the current DateTime with correct timezone and offset.

methods.name: testGetTimezoneByTimezoneOffset
methods.description: Checks that timezone objects are correctly created for given offsets.

methods.name: testGetWeekBoundaryForGivenDate
methods.description: Verifies week boundary calculation for various start days of the week and dates.
